Scar Revision Surgery in Bangalore

What Is SCAR REVISION SURGERY?

Scar revision improves selected features of a scar, such as width, thickness, direction, contour, symptoms or restricted movement. Surgical methods include removing and re-closing the scar, redirecting it through local tissue rearrangement, releasing a contracture, or using grafts in selected cases. Non-surgical options may also be part of a broader plan. The approach depends on scar type, location, skin quality, previous healing and whether function is affected. Revision does not remove a scar entirely and can create a new surgical scar, so treatment is planned around whether the expected improvement justifies that trade-off.

Plan Your Scar Revision Surgery Around Your Treatment Goals

The consultation matches your desired result with what is clinically appropriate. The team reviews your concerns, suitability, treatment options, expected recovery, cost factors and follow-up needs before recommending a personalised plan.

OUR PROCESS

Our Scar Revision Surgery Process

The clinician reviews scar age, thickness, colour, direction, symptoms and surrounding skin.

Options may include surgical excision, tissue rearrangement, laser or other scar-management approaches, depending on the scar.

The expected scar trade-off and the risk of recurrence or pigment change are discussed before treatment.

The chosen treatment is performed according to scar type and location.

Patients receive wound and scar-care guidance suited to the procedure.

Healing, scar maturation and any need for additional treatment are reviewed over time.

Who Can Benefit from Scar Revision Surgery?

  • Patients with Widened Surgical Scars

    Scars that have stretched or widened after surgery may be assessed for excision and re-closure if the surrounding tissue is suitable.

  • Patients with Raised or Thick Scars

    Hypertrophic or other thick scars may need a combination of medical, procedural or surgical management based on how the scar behaves.

  • Patients with Burn or Traumatic Scars

    Scars from burns or injuries may be treated when they are prominent, symptomatic or restrict function.

  • Patients with Contracture Scars

    Scars that tighten across a joint or facial region and limit movement may need release or tissue rearrangement.

  • Patients with Depressed or Irregular Scars

    Selected contour irregularities may suit surgical or adjunctive correction after clinical assessment.

Scar revision is planned around facial anatomy, surgical precision, recovery and natural-looking results.

Scar Revision Surgery Cost and Consultation in Bangalore

Cost depends on scar type, treatment method, size and location of the area, and whether multiple sessions are needed.

  1. 01

    Scar Type & Size

    Larger, thicker or more complex scars may need more extensive treatment.

  2. 02

    Scar Location

    Scars near joints, facial features or other functionally important areas may require more detailed planning.

  3. 03

    Surgical vs Non-Surgical Treatment

    Procedure type directly affects resources, facility needs and recovery.

  4. 04

    Number of Sessions

    Some scars require more than one treatment or staged management.

  5. 05

    Adjunctive Treatment

    Laser, injections or other additional treatments may change the overall care plan.
